assignment.absence: None, never canonical fallback for acceptance gates

corridor.rule: assignment-indexed adaptation of POS04.AtomicCorridor; one carrier change, source/target event expansion and successive-stage dependencies

post_exit_retention.derivation: resource is copied verbatim from base /new_data/maintenance/target_resource; baseline retained_resources includes it iff base /new_data/raw_inputs/by_tag/target/resources/recharge_available_after_withdrawal is true; no arrival primitive changes

disturbance_interface.rule: Minimal nonempty exogenous maintenance-request domain; nominal leaves assigned action probabilities, hazards and resource supply unchanged. POS-04 supplies actions but no disturbance table.

effect.nominal: identity on assigned rows, hazards, resources and ledger

disturbance_interface.limitation: Singleton nominal environment only; no adversarial/nontrivial disturbance robustness.

response_semantics.action_owner_rule: Target-owned onboard controller; encode the assigned target resource owner as the action owner, and check target equality.
response_semantics.quantifiers: For every invariant factor state, every declared raw route-register context, and every declared disturbance, there exists a target-owned action such that every positive-probability successor lies inside the invariant.
response_semantics.row_rule: Assigned target actionRow at denominator 4, nonempty, sum of numerators 4; nominal effect is identity; out-of-K or nonpositive entries reject.
response_semantics.resource_rule: Required target_recharge retained and target-owned; no withdrawn dependency may supply the response.
response_semantics.budget_rule: Prior unit budget minus assigned action cost plus effective recharge; effective recharge is assigned recharge iff target_recharge is available after retention, else zero; require conserved and strictly positive budget.
response_semantics.run_update_rule: Use assignment-defined C6 updater: counter/progress +1; ticks + assigned ticks for the actual state/action; record +1 only with funded availability and target writer for the retained route context; raw tuple register and target owner persist. Check positive unit advances and all closure-wide readout laws.
response_semantics.probabilistic_safety: all supported successors, not one lucky outcome
response_semantics.factor_run_separation: Finite K factor; unbounded run counters and ledger lift; no strict increasing finite-state rank.

withdrawal_rule.rule: After the fixed withdrawal phase, none of these roles is available or used by a response. Keep only target-owned internal policy/writers and explicitly retained named target resources.
withdrawal_rule.new_modeling: Explicit raw role-removal interface, derived from the withdrawal intervention in POST_WITHDRAWAL_AUTONOMY.md:3; not stored certificate proofs.

raw_interface.autonomy_entry_rule: For each raw route, execute the actual phase-2 funded target row from its computed receiver output; collect every supported successor with its resulting register/counters. Every resulting withdrawal entry must be inside the computed invariant; do not reset to the earlier receiver factor.

fixed_predicates.package: Shared P, G6 spec §2: mapped/glued ARRIVAL target assignment and all assigned C1–C8 checks plus map/totality/gluing equations.
fixed_predicates.lineage: Shared L, G6 spec §3: assignment-indexed G4 atomic corridor plus G1c raw bridge/signature/endpoint laws.
fixed_predicates.autonomy_full: AF, G6 spec §4F: package-filtered greatest invariant with packageInside and target-owned probability-one-safe responses for EVERY declared disturbance and every invariant state/context, resource closure and run laws.
fixed_predicates.autonomy_operational: AO, G6 spec §4O: C8 greatest8 invariant and the same nominal disturbance/response/resource/run rules, WITHOUT P or C1–C7 packageInside; N3 supplementary.
